sloka: श्रूयते हि पुरा तात श्रुतिर्गीता यशस्विना ।गयेन यजमानेन गयेष्वेव पितऽन् प्रति ॥ २.१०७.११॥
transliteration: śrūyate hi purā tāta śrutirgītā yaśasvinā ।gayena yajamānena gayeṣveva pita'n prati ॥ 2.107.11॥

translations.english: Dear (brother), it is heard that long ago an illustrious king while performing a sacrifice intended for ancestors at a sacred place known as Gaya, the sacrificer Gaya chanted a Vedic hymn as follows:
